print.name: PRINT
print.description: Outputs a value to the form.

get.name: GET
get.description: Retrieves a value from a record by key (tag, string, or number).

set.name: SET
set.description: Returns a new record with the specified key updated.

nth.name: NTH
nth.description: Returns the nth element of a list by index.

sub.name: SUB
sub.description: Subtracts the second number from the first.

div.name: DIV
div.description: Divides the first number by the second.

filter.name: FILTER
filter.description: Returns a list of elements that match a predicate.

reduce.name: REDUCE
reduce.description: Reduces a list to a single value using a binary function and initial value.

map.name: MAP
map.description: Applies a function to each element in a list and returns a new list.

lt.name: LT
lt.description: Returns true if the first value is less than the second.

le.name: LE
le.description: Returns true if the first value is less than or equal to the second.

gt.name: GT
gt.description: Returns true if the first value is greater than the second.

ge.name: GE
ge.description: Returns true if the first value is greater than or equal to the second.

ne.name: NE
ne.description: Returns true if the two values are not equal.

length.name: LENGTH
length.description: Returns the length of a list, string, or record.

concat.name: CONCAT
concat.description: Concatenates two strings or two lists.

pow.name: POW
pow.description: Raises the first number to the power of the second.

apply.name: APPLY
apply.description: Applies a function to a list of arguments.

data.name: DATA
data.description: Returns the data from the upstream task, or the argument value if no input exists.

use.name: USE
use.description: Inside `data`, declares the upstream language whose output is expected (e.g. `data use "0166"`). The console resolves the language's schema at write time; at runtime falls back to {} when no upstream is bound.

str.name: STR_OF
str.description: Converts any value to display text: a string as itself, a number, boolean, null or tag as written (`red`), and a list or record in Graffiticode syntax (`[1 "a"]`, `{a: 1}`). Template literals apply it to each `${…}`.

format-number.name: FORMAT_NUMBER
format-number.description: Formats a number as text by an Excel number-format pattern: `format-number "#,##0.00" 1234.5` is "1,234.50". Supports 0 # ? placeholders, the decimal point, thousands commas, %, scientific E+00, quoted literal text and positive;negative;zero sections. Rounds half away from zero, exactly.

eq.name: EQ
eq.description: Returns true if the two values are equal.

mod.name: MOD
mod.description: Returns the remainder of dividing the first number by the second.

min.name: MIN
min.description: Returns the smaller of two values.

max.name: MAX
max.description: Returns the larger of two values.

range.name: RANGE
range.description: Generates a list of numbers from start to end using a step.

not.name: NOT
not.description: Returns the logical negation of a boolean value.

equiv.name: EQUIV
equiv.description: Returns true if the two values are semantically equivalent.

or.name: OR
or.description: Returns true if at least one of the two values is true.

and.name: AND
and.description: Returns true if both values are true.

hd.name: HD
hd.description: Returns the first element of a list.

tl.name: TL
tl.description: Returns the list without its first element.

cons.name: CONS
cons.description: Prepends an element to the front of a list.

append.name: APPEND
append.description: Appends an element to the end of a list.

log.name: LOG
log.description: Logs the value to the console and returns the value (identity function).

isempty.name: ISEMPTY
isempty.description: Returns true if the list is empty, otherwise returns false.

last.name: LAST
last.description: Returns the last element of a list.

drop.name: DROP
drop.description: Returns a list with the first n elements removed.

take.name: TAKE
take.description: Returns the first n elements of a list.

get-var.name: GET_VAR
get-var.description: Gets the value of a named variable.

get-val-private.name: GET_VAL_PRIVATE
get-val-private.description: Resolves a variable by name, encrypted at parse time and decrypted at compile time.

get-val-public.name: GET_VAL_PUBLIC
get-val-public.description: Resolves a variable by name as plain text.

set-var.name: SET_VAR
set-var.description: Sets a named variable to a value.

board.name: BOARD
board.description: The program: the board's pages, then its settings (title, show-page-tabs, show-page-menu, layout-profile).

page.name: PAGE
page.description: One page, arranged on its own: its marks, sections, groups and connectors, then its settings (id, name, background, layout, direction, columns).

section.name: SECTION
section.description: A visible, named area holding marks and groups, then its settings (id, name, fill, opacity, layout, direction, columns, before). A section cannot hold another section.

group.name: GROUP
group.description: An invisible layout region: arranges its children as one block, with no frame or title, then its settings (id, layout, direction, columns, before).

sticky.name: STICKY
sticky.description: A sticky note of plain text, e.g. `sticky id "idea" text "Idea" {}`.

shape.name: SHAPE
shape.description: A shape with text in it, e.g. `shape id "valid" text "Valid?" kind DIAMOND {}`.

textbox.name: TEXTBOX
textbox.description: Standalone text, measured and wrapped by the compiler, e.g. `textbox id "heading" text "Agenda" font-size LARGE {}`.

connector.name: CONNECTOR
connector.description: A line from one mark to another on the same page, e.g. `connector id "a-b" from "a" to "b" label "next" {}`. Written directly in the page.

id.name: ID
id.description: The object's identity, unique on the board. Connectors and `before` refer to it. Required on every page, section, group, mark and connector.

text.name: TEXT
text.description: The full plain text of a sticky, shape or textbox. Required on each; it may be empty.

name.name: NAME
name.description: A page's or section's name, shown as its tab or title. Required on both.

title.name: TITLE
title.description: The board's title, after the board's `]`.

kind.name: KIND
kind.description: A shape's outline: SQUARE (the default), ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, DIAMOND, PARALLELOGRAM_RIGHT, PREDEFINED_PROCESS, DOCUMENT_SINGLE or ENG_DATABASE.

layout.name: LAYOUT
layout.description: How a page, section or group arranges its direct children: AUTO (the default), ROW, COLUMN, GRID (with `columns`) or FLOW (with an optional `direction`).

direction.name: DIRECTION
direction.description: The direction a FLOW progresses: RIGHT (the default), LEFT, DOWN or UP. Only with `layout FLOW`.

columns.name: COLUMNS
columns.description: How many columns a GRID has: a positive whole number. Only with `layout GRID`, which requires it.

before.name: BEFORE
before.description: The ids of siblings this child must come before in its parent's FLOW, e.g. `before ["b" "c"]`. Only on a direct child of a `layout FLOW` region.

from.name: FROM
from.description: The id of the sticky, shape or textbox a connector starts at. Required.

to.name: TO
to.description: The id of the sticky, shape or textbox a connector ends at. Required.

fill.name: FILL
fill.description: The colour of a sticky, shape or section: a hex code like "#ffcc00", or red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, pink, white, black, gray.

stroke.name: STROKE
stroke.description: The colour of a shape's outline or a connector's line.

color.name: COLOR
color.description: The colour of a textbox's text.

opacity.name: OPACITY
opacity.description: How opaque, from 0 (invisible) to 100 (solid). Defaults to 100. An invisible object still takes its place in the layout.

font-size.name: FONT_SIZE
font-size.description: Text size: SMALL (16), MEDIUM (24, the default for marks), LARGE (40), EXTRA_LARGE (64) or HUGE (96). A connector label defaults to SMALL.

stroke-width.name: STROKE_WIDTH
stroke-width.description: Line thickness: THIN (4, the default) or THICK (8).

line-style.name: LINE_STYLE
line-style.description: A connector's dash: SOLID (the default) or DASHED.

from-cap.name: FROM_CAP
from-cap.description: The cap at a connector's start: NONE (the default), ARROW_LINES, ARROW_EQUILATERAL, TRIANGLE_FILLED, CIRCLE_FILLED or DIAMOND_FILLED.

to-cap.name: TO_CAP
to-cap.description: The cap at a connector's end: ARROW_LINES (the default), NONE, ARROW_EQUILATERAL, TRIANGLE_FILLED, CIRCLE_FILLED or DIAMOND_FILLED.

show-page-tabs.name: SHOW_PAGE_TABS
show-page-tabs.description: Show a tab per page in the preview. Defaults to true with two or more pages, false with one.

show-page-menu.name: SHOW_PAGE_MENU
show-page-menu.description: Show the page menu in the preview. Defaults to false.

layout-profile.name: LAYOUT_PROFILE
layout-profile.description: The fixed measurement, layout and validation policy the board is compiled with: FIGJAM_V1, which is also what an omitted profile means.

save-to-figjam.name: SAVE_TO_FIGJAM
save-to-figjam.description: Draw this board into a FigJam file with the Graffiticode FigJam plugin: `save-to-figjam "<file key or figma.com link>"`, on its own line before the board. Without it the board is a preview.

AUTO.name: TAG
AUTO.description: Arrange the children as the compiler sees fit, using containment and connections.

ROW.name: TAG
ROW.description: Keep the children in order, left to right, without wrapping.

COLUMN.name: TAG
COLUMN.description: Keep the children in order, top to bottom, without wrapping.

GRID.name: TAG
GRID.description: Keep the children in order, row by row, in `columns` columns.

FLOW.name: TAG
FLOW.description: Lay the children out along `direction`, following their connectors and `before` orders.

RIGHT.name: TAG
RIGHT.description: A flow that progresses left to right.

LEFT.name: TAG
LEFT.description: A flow that progresses right to left.

DOWN.name: TAG
DOWN.description: A flow that progresses top to bottom.

UP.name: TAG
UP.description: A flow that progresses bottom to top.

PREDEFINED_PROCESS.name: TAG
PREDEFINED_PROCESS.description: A rectangle with a bar at each side.

DOCUMENT_SINGLE.name: TAG
DOCUMENT_SINGLE.description: A page with a wavy bottom edge.

NONE.name: TAG
NONE.description: No end cap (the default at a connector's start).

ARROW_LINES.name: TAG
ARROW_LINES.description: An open arrowhead (the default at a connector's end).

FIGJAM_V1.name: TAG
FIGJAM_V1.description: The first measurement, layout and validation profile (the default).
